title: Spiced Hot Cross Buns with Raisins and Orange Peel
summary: A milk and butter dough spiced with cinnamon, ginger and cardamom is studded with raisins and candied orange peel, shaped into 12 buns, piped with flour-paste crosses and baked, then brushed with sugar glaze while hot.

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Dough
steps.text: Knead the spiced dough, then knead in the fruit.

steps.title: Shape
steps.text: Shape 12 tight buns and prove in the tin until touching.

steps.title: Crosses
steps.text: Pipe thick flour-paste lines across each row in both directions.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Bake until browned and 88-93 °C in the centre.

steps.title: Glaze
steps.text: Brush with hot sugar syrup and serve warm.

tips: Tuck the fruit under as you shape so it does not burn on the surface.
Make the paste thick enough to hold a line when piped.
Glaze the buns while hot for a sticky shine.
storage: Keep airtight at room temperature for up to 2 days, or freeze for up to 1 month. Toast split buns and serve with butter. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
